personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受「车间环境、计件收入，但技能越多越值钱」的现实，这行可以长期干。

fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合反应快、坐得住、对安全有数的人。你愿意把「落点准 + 不出事」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你反应快、坐得住、把「落点准 + 不出事」当标准，工程机械操作是基建圈最练手感的入口。

boundary_notice: The risk in this field lies in only knowing how to follow drawings and run cables. Wireless equipment and smart platforms simplify construction. Move toward commissioning, integration, maintenance, and credentials; the stricter the regulations become, the more valuable you become.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who fear heights, dislike dirty conditions, or are careless. Ceilings, shafts, and rooftops are common work areas, and one incorrect connection can disable alarms across an entire floor. People without sufficient responsibility cannot do this work.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study electrical work, low-voltage systems, or a related program at a technical school → low-voltage installer → electrician and fire protection facilities operator credentials → alarm control panel programming and integrated commissioning expertise → project manager, fire protection engineer, or low-voltage engineering manager.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits careful people with strong hands-on skills who can work at height. Cable runs must be straight and orderly, no conductor can be connected incorrectly, and commissioning logic must be clear. Dust and frequent climbing on construction sites are routine.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you do not mind dust or working at height and take every wire and device location seriously, this field offers a building-technology career where longer credentialed experience increases your value.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Hands-on ability: stable and accurate wiring and installation
Logical thinking: understand integrated commissioning clearly
Attention to detail: prevent connection and device-location errors
Responsibility: never cut corners on safety systems
Service awareness: teach owners to use the system

boundary_notice: 这行的风险在「只会按图布线」——无线设备和智能平台在简化施工。往调试、联动、维保和持证方向走，法规越严，你越值钱。

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合恐高、怕脏、粗心的人。吊顶里、竖井里、天台顶都是工作场景，接线错一根可能让整层楼报警失效，责任心不够的人干不了。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：学电工/弱电相关专业或技校 → 从弱电安装工做起 → 考取电工证、消防设施操作员证 → 熟悉报警主机编程与联动调试 → 往项目经理、消防工程师或弱电工程管理方向升级。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合动手能力强、细心、能爬高的人。布线要横平竖直、接线不能错一根，调试时逻辑要清楚，工地里灰大爬上爬下也是常态。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你不怕灰、不怕爬高，还愿意把每根线、每个点位都当回事，这行给你一条持证越久越值钱的楼宇技术路。

逻辑思维：联动调试理得清
责任心：安全系统不敢糊弄
服务意识：教得会业主用

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This occupation does not suit people who dislike tedious work, repetition, or conflict. Reviews and collections contain many standardized actions, complete audit trails, and adversarial disputes, which are difficult for restless or overly accommodating people.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is to study taxation, finance, accounting, or law, enter through the civil service examination, complete pre-service training, begin in examination or collection, and transfer into auditing or supervision.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can sit patiently, examine accurately, and safeguard the public ledger within the rules, taxation is one of the most stable entry points into public finance.

Principled: does not compromise red lines

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people with poor direction, motion sickness, social anxiety, or an aversion to sun. Leading tours combines physical and emotional labor, requiring eight hours of speaking and constant responses to unexpected situations.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study tourism management or a foreign language, earn the national tour guide qualification, begin as a local guide or tour escort, build route knowledge and a presentation style, then specialize in themed travel such as educational, outbound, or premium customized tours or move into tourism planning.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits articulate, outgoing, attentive people. A strong guide can tell jokes, remember where a visitor keeps medication, manage tickets, meals, and rooms for 40 people alone, and steady the entire group when a wallet is lost or transportation is missed.

personality_fit_block.callout: For articulate, energetic people who genuinely enjoy interacting with others, tour guiding turns a passion into a livelihood.

personality_fit_block.callout: 嘴皮子利索、腿脚利索、又真心喜欢跟人打交道的人，导游是能把爱好当饭吃的职业。

外向热情：自来熟、会暖场
应变力：突发状况稳得住
体力和耐心：走一天讲一天
